actions.title: Gather lighting and batteries
actions.explanation: Keep flashlights and spare batteries easy to find.
actions.alternative: Choose a familiar place for flashlights, battery lanterns and extra batteries.

actions.title: Keep a way to stay informed
actions.explanation: Prepare phone chargers and a battery-powered radio.
actions.alternative: Keep a power bank and battery-powered weather radio with your supplies.

actions.title: Check your essential supplies
actions.explanation: Review your food and water supplies before an outage.
actions.alternative: Check that your household has food and water ready.

checklist.title: Write down important contacts
checklist.explanation: Keep a paper contact list and agree how your household will reconnect.
